the interaction between the two solitons is similar to that in a single-mode fiber, but with the added complication of intermodal four-wave-mixing power transfer.

the interaction between the two fundamental solitons is similar to the case in single mode fibers, but the total power in two modes is not conserved and the power is exchanged between two modes through intermodal nonlinear effects.

the interaction of two fundamental solitons in the two degenerates modes of a multimodal fiber can be treated as if they were interacting in a single-mode fiber, provided the intermodal four wave mixing effect is taken into account.

the interaction between two solitons propagates in two different modes of a multimodal fiber is similar to the interaction in a single-mode fiber, but the intermodal four-wave-mixing effect makes each soliton to interact with the other mode.

, in spite a bimodal nature of the solitons, the interaction is governed by the same rules as in a single-mode fiber.

, in spite the intermodal nature and the associated four-wave mixing, solitons in the two modes of a multimoded fiber can be treated as if they were in a single-mode fiber, and their interaction can be described using the standard nonlinear Schrödinger equation.

the interaction of solitons belonging to two different fiber modes is similar to the case when the solitons belong to the same fiber mode, and hence, the interaction of soliton pairs belonging to different fiber modes can be studied in a similar manner as the interaction of solitions in a single-mode fiber.
